title: A small-width DNF for the restriction of an OR gate
statement: Let $c_1,\dots,c_m$ be Boolean circuits on $n$ variables, let $\rho$ be a restriction of those variables, and let $l$ be a natural number. For a Boolean function $g$ write $g\!\restriction_\rho$ for its restriction by $\rho$, the function $x \mapsto g(\rho.\mathrm{extend}\,x)$ that fixes each coordinate assigned by $\rho$ and reads the remaining coordinates from $x$. Suppose that for every child $c$ among $c_1,\dots,c_m$ the restricted function $c\!\restriction_\rho$ is computed by some decision tree of depth at most $l$. Then there is a DNF formula $\varphi$ of width at most $l$ that computes the restriction $F\!\restriction_\rho$ of the OR gate $F$ over the children, i.e.\ $\varphi(x) = F\!\restriction_\rho(x)$ for every assignment $x$, where $F$ evaluates to the disjunction of the values $c_1,\dots,c_m$.
hypotheses_covered: c_1,...,c_m are Boolean circuits on n variables
rho is a restriction of the variables
every child's restricted function has decision-tree depth at most l
replaced:
If every child $c \in cs$ satisfies $\mathrm{dtDepth}(\mathrm{restrictFn}\,c.\mathrm{eval}\,\rho) \le l$,
then there is a DNF $\varphi$ of width at most $l$ that computes the restriction of the OR node:
$\mathrm{DNF.eval}\,\varphi\,x = \mathrm{restrictFn}\,(\mathrm{eval}\,(\mathrm{node}\,\mathrm{false}\,cs))\,\rho\,x$
for all $x$.
